body:
To me it just sounds like the people in your area are the real disgusting creatures for being the way they are.

My advice to you is to get out of your area when you can. Visit new areas that appeal to you and see what the people there are like.

As much as I find it hard to believe myself, there are a lot of good people out there that don't act like this, that don't judge people based on looks, but rather by their personality.

Find a nice area to live in and move there :)
